newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: TV3's cable service gets more channels.
newsitem.headline: TV3's cable service gets more channels.

text.p: Private television operator Sistem Televisyen Malaysia Bhd (TV3) said on Monday that its Mega TV cable concern has been granted government approval to double the number of its channels to 10.

In a statement, TV3 said its associate company Cableview Services Sdn Bhd, the operator of Mega TV, was given the green light "in principle" to operate another five channels in addition to its existing five. It did not elaborate.
Mega TV and Astro, which is owned by unlisted Binariang Sdn Bhd, are Malaysia's two cable TV operators.
